senses.en: a diagram showing the steps of a process, often with boxes and arrows

example.en: The teacher drew a flowchart to explain how the program works.
example.zh: 老师画了一张流程图来解释程序的运行方式。

senses.en: primates such as gorillas, chimpanzees, and gibbons; plural of ape

example.en: Chimpanzees and gorillas are apes.
example.zh: 黑猩猩和大猩猩都属于猿类。

senses.en: imitates someone, often in a silly or unoriginal way; third-person singular of ape
senses.zh: 模仿；（常指拙劣地）效仿（ape 的第三人称单数）

example.en: He apes his older brother's way of speaking.
example.zh: 他模仿哥哥说话的方式。

senses.en: the hard parts that form the skeleton of humans and animals

example.en: Doctors examined the bones in her wrist.
example.zh: 医生检查了她手腕的骨头。

senses.en: causing strong feelings of sadness or sympathy

example.en: The film ends with a poignant scene between mother and daughter.
example.zh: 影片以母女之间令人心酸的一幕结束。

senses.en: sharp and penetrating in effect

example.en: Her story made a poignant impression on everyone present.
example.zh: 她的故事给在场的每个人留下了深刻的印象。

senses.en: relating to the abdomen

example.en: He felt mild abdominal pain after the meal.
example.zh: 饭后他感到轻微的腹痛。

senses.en: an abdominal muscle, usually in the plural

example.en: Regular exercise helps strengthen the abdominals.
example.zh: 经常锻炼有助于增强腹肌。

senses.en: relating to style, especially in language or art

example.en: The editor suggested a few stylistic changes to the article.
example.zh: 编辑对文章提出了几处文体上的修改建议。

senses.en: a long, narrow piece of something

example.en: A strip of tape held the box closed.
example.zh: 一条胶带把盒子封住了。

senses.en: to remove a covering or layer from something

example.en: He stripped the old wallpaper from the wall.
example.zh: 他把旧墙纸从墙上剥了下来。

senses.en: to take away rights or possessions from someone

example.en: The court stripped him of his title.
example.zh: 法院剥夺了他的头衔。

senses.en: to take off your clothes

example.en: He stripped off his wet clothes and hung them up.
example.zh: 他脱下湿衣服挂了起来。

senses.en: Many times; over and over again.

example.en: She repeatedly asked for more information.
example.zh: 她一再要求提供更多信息。

senses.en: woven or knitted material used for making clothes, curtains, and other things

example.en: She bought some cloth to make curtains.
example.zh: 她买了一些布做窗帘。

senses.en: a piece of cloth used for wiping or cleaning something

example.en: He wiped the table with a damp cloth.
example.zh: 他用一块湿布擦桌子。

senses.en: the act of coming down to the ground or arriving after a flight

example.en: The plane made a smooth landing.
example.zh: 飞机平稳着陆。

senses.en: a flat area at the top of a staircase or between flights of stairs

example.en: She waited on the landing.
example.zh: 她在楼梯平台上等候。

senses.en: a place where boats can land people or goods

example.en: The ferry pulled up to the landing.
example.zh: 渡船靠上了码头。

senses.en: an atom or molecule with an electric charge, positive or negative

example.en: A positive ion is formed when an atom loses an electron.
example.zh: 原子失去电子时会形成正离子。

senses.en: to make someone feel less tired or hot by giving rest, food, or drink

example.en: A cold drink will refresh you after the long walk.
example.zh: 长途步行后，一杯冷饮会让你恢复精神。

senses.en: to update a computer screen or webpage to show the latest information

example.en: Click this button to refresh the page.
example.zh: 点击这个按钮来刷新页面。

senses.en: to remind someone of something they had forgotten

example.en: She looked at her notes to refresh her memory before the meeting.
example.zh: 开会前她看了看笔记以唤起记忆。

senses.en: to separate and go in different directions

example.en: The two roads diverge just past the bridge.
example.zh: 两条路在桥那头刚过去就分岔了。

senses.en: to differ in opinion or develop in different ways

example.en: Their views on the project began to diverge over time.
example.zh: 他们对这个项目的看法逐渐产生了分歧。

senses.en: something of little value or importance

example.en: Don't worry about such a trifle.
example.zh: 别为这种小事担心。

senses.en: slightly; a little (used in the phrase "a trifle")

example.en: She seemed a trifle nervous before the interview.
example.zh: 面试前她似乎有点紧张。

senses.en: to waste time or treat something lightly

example.en: He trifled away the whole afternoon.
example.zh: 他把整个下午都虚度了。

senses.en: a British dessert of layered sponge cake, fruit, jelly, and cream
senses.zh: （英国）屈莱弗甜点（蛋糕、果冻、奶油分层甜点）

example.en: She made a sherry trifle for dessert.
example.zh: 她做了雪利酒甜点作为餐后甜品。

senses.en: a substance that makes something dirty or less pure

example.en: The water was filtered to remove impurities.
example.zh: 这水经过过滤以去除杂质。

senses.en: the state or quality of being impure

example.en: The impurity of the sample affected the test results.
example.zh: 样品的不纯影响了检测结果。

senses.en: decorative items such as rings, necklaces and bracelets, often made of precious metals and gems

example.en: She wore a simple necklace, the only jewelry she owned.
example.zh: 她戴着一条简单的项链，那是她唯一的珠宝。

senses.en: the way someone stands; a person's position or attitude on an issue

example.en: The company's stance on climate change has won public support.
example.zh: 该公司在气候变化问题上的立场赢得了公众支持。

senses.en: causing severe damage or destruction
senses.zh: 毁灭性的；破坏力极大的

example.en: The earthquake had a devastating effect on the city.
example.zh: 地震对这座城市造成了毁灭性的影响。

senses.en: shocking or overwhelming emotionally

example.en: She received some devastating news about her job.
example.zh: 她收到了一些关于工作的令她深受打击的消息。

senses.en: (informal) impressively effective or striking
senses.zh: （非正式）极有感染力的；令人印象深刻的

example.en: She gave a devastating performance in the play.
example.zh: 她在这部戏里的表演令人印象深刻。

senses.en: (US) an elevated railway or its train

example.en: They took the el to the north side of the city.
example.zh: 他们乘高架列车去了城的北部。

senses.en: a thin layer that covers or separates parts of a living thing

example.en: The cell membrane controls what enters the cell.
example.zh: 细胞膜控制物质进出细胞。

senses.en: a thin flexible sheet of material

example.en: A thin membrane covers the top of the container.
example.zh: 容器顶部覆盖着一层薄膜。

senses.en: a place where children go to learn and be taught

example.en: She walks to school every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早上走路去上学。

senses.en: a group of fish or other sea creatures swimming together

example.en: We saw a school of fish near the shore.
example.zh: 我们在近岸处看到一群鱼。

senses.en: a group of people sharing the same ideas or style in art, thought, or science

example.en: He belongs to a new school of economic thought.
example.zh: 他属于一个新的经济学派。

senses.en: to train someone, especially to behave in a certain way

example.en: Years of travel schooled her in patience.
example.zh: 多年的旅行磨炼了她的耐心。

senses.en: the quality of light that makes things appear red, blue, yellow, etc.

example.en: What is your favourite colour?
example.zh: 你最喜欢什么颜色？

senses.en: colouring material such as paint or dye

example.en: The artist mixed several colours on the palette.
example.zh: 画家在调色板上调了几种颜料。

senses.en: to add colour to something using paint, pens, etc.

example.en: The children coloured the picture with crayons.
example.zh: 孩子们用蜡笔给图画上色。

senses.en: to affect or influence an opinion or judgement
senses.zh: 影响（观点、判断）；使带偏见

example.en: Personal experience coloured her view of the policy.
example.zh: 个人经历影响了她对这项政策的看法。

senses.en: to talk about something with others in order to share ideas or decide

example.en: We discussed the plan during the meeting.
example.zh: 我们在会上讨论了这个计划。

senses.en: completely or entirely

example.en: The bridge is now fully open to traffic.
example.zh: 这座桥现在已全面通车。

senses.en: sufficiently or more than adequately

example.en: She was fully prepared for the interview.
example.zh: 她为面试做好了充分准备。

senses.en: the day of the week between Sunday and Tuesday

example.en: The meeting is on Monday.
example.zh: 会议在星期一举行。

senses.en: an animal without a backbone, such as an insect or worm

example.en: Insects, worms and jellyfish are all invertebrates.
example.zh: 昆虫、蠕虫和水母都是无脊椎动物。

senses.en: lacking a backbone or spinal column

example.en: Snails are invertebrate animals with soft bodies.
example.zh: 蜗牛是身体柔软的无脊椎动物。

senses.en: a person who tends a herd of animals

example.en: A herder guided the sheep across the valley.
example.zh: 一位牧人领着羊群穿过山谷。

senses.en: impossible to understand; too deep to be measured
senses.zh: 深不可测的；难以理解的

example.en: The ocean floor is unfathomable in many places.
example.zh: 海底许多地方深不可测。

senses.en: the long central structure along the bottom of a ship

example.en: Workers laid the keel of a new ship.
example.zh: 工人们铺设了一艘新船的龙骨。

senses.en: to turn over on its side (of a boat or person)

example.en: The small boat keeled over in the storm.
example.zh: 小船在风暴中倾覆了。

senses.en: the time in the morning when light first appears

example.en: The fishermen set out at daybreak.
example.zh: 渔民们在黎明时分出发。

senses.en: behavior or language that is rude and lacking taste

example.en: The film was criticized for its vulgarity.
example.zh: 这部电影因粗俗而受到批评。

senses.en: clear enough to be read

example.en: The doctor's handwriting was barely legible.
example.zh: 这位医生的笔迹几乎无法辨认。

senses.en: to divide something into two equal parts

example.en: A new road bisects the town.
example.zh: 一条新路把小镇一分为二。

senses.en: regularly found among particular people or in a certain area

example.en: Malaria is endemic in some tropical regions.
example.zh: 疟疾在一些热带地区是地方性流行病。

senses.en: native to and restricted to a certain place

example.en: This bird is endemic to the island.
example.zh: 这种鸟是该岛特有的。

senses.en: a plant or animal naturally found only in a particular area; also a disease regularly present in a particular population or area

example.en: The lake harbors an endemic found nowhere else.
example.zh: 这个湖栖息着一种别处没有的特有物种。

senses.en: a piece of clothing worn for swimming

example.en: She packed her swimsuit for the beach trip.
example.zh: 她为海滩之行打包了泳衣。

senses.en: the small hollow on the stomach where the umbilical cord was attached

example.en: The doctor examined the baby's navel.
example.zh: 医生检查了婴儿的肚脐。

senses.en: the central point of something (often figurative)

example.en: The city was once the navel of the fashion world.
example.zh: 这座城市曾是时尚世界的中心。

senses.en: a hat tied under the chin, formerly worn by women and children

example.en: The baby wore a woolen bonnet against the cold.
example.zh: 婴儿戴着羊毛软帽御寒。

senses.en: (British English) the metal cover over a car's engine; hood

example.en: He lifted the bonnet to check the engine.
example.zh: 他掀起引擎盖检查发动机。

senses.en: a building where people live

example.en: They bought a small house near the park.
example.zh: 他们在公园附近买了一栋小房子。

senses.en: to provide someone with a place to live

example.en: The charity houses homeless families.
example.zh: 这家慈善机构为无家可归的家庭提供住处。

senses.en: to contain or store something

example.en: The museum houses a collection of ancient coins.
example.zh: 博物馆收藏了一批古钱币。

senses.en: a legislative assembly, especially the lower or upper chamber

example.en: The bill passed the House by a narrow margin.
example.zh: 该法案以微弱优势在议院获得通过。

senses.en: used in questions and negatives to mean some or even a small amount
senses.zh: 一些；任何的（用于疑问句或否定句）

example.en: Do you have any questions?
example.zh: 你有任何问题吗？

senses.en: one or some of a thing, without saying which

example.en: Take any of these books.
example.zh: 这些书你拿哪一本都行。

senses.en: at all; to any degree

example.en: Is she any better today?
example.zh: 她今天好些了吗？

senses.en: a long step in walking or running

example.en: He crossed the room in three strides.
example.zh: 他三大步就跨过了房间。

senses.en: progress or improvement in an activity

example.en: The company is making great strides in technology.
example.zh: 这家公司在技术上正取得长足进步。

senses.en: to walk with long, quick steps

example.en: She strode confidently into the meeting room.
example.zh: 她自信地大步走进会议室。

senses.en: a repeated back-and-forth or shaking movement

example.en: The vibration of the phone woke him up.
example.zh: 手机的振动把他吵醒了。

senses.en: a slight trembling feeling or movement

example.en: She felt a vibration in the floor as the train passed.
example.zh: 火车经过时，她感到地板在微微颤动。

senses.en: vertical; standing straight up

example.en: Please keep the box upright during transport.
example.zh: 运输时请保持箱子直立。

senses.en: honest and morally good

example.en: He is known as an upright and fair judge.
example.zh: 他以正直公正著称。

senses.en: a vertical post or supporting member

example.en: One of the fence uprights was broken.
example.zh: 栅栏的一根立柱断了。

senses.en: in or into an upright position

example.en: She sat upright in her chair.
example.zh: 她端坐在椅子上。

senses.en: lower in quality or value than something else

example.en: The store sells cheap but inferior goods.
example.zh: 这家店出售便宜但质量较差的商品。

senses.en: lower in rank, status, or position

example.en: He treated his inferior colleagues with disrespect.
example.zh: 他对职位较低的同事态度无礼。

senses.en: a person of lower rank or status

example.en: A good manager respects his inferiors.
example.zh: 好的管理者尊重自己的下属。

senses.en: located below or lower than something else (anatomy)

example.en: The inferior vena cava carries blood to the heart.
example.zh: 下腔静脉将血液输送回心脏。

senses.en: a strong feeling of shame or embarrassment

example.en: Losing the game in front of everyone was a deep humiliation.
example.zh: 在所有人面前输了比赛是一次深深的羞辱。

senses.en: an event or action that makes someone lose face or self-respect

example.en: The scandal was a humiliation for the whole company.
example.zh: 这桩丑闻是整个公司的耻辱。

senses.en: following one after another in sequence

example.en: It rained for three successive days.
example.zh: 接连下了三天雨。

senses.en: friendly and generous treatment of guests or strangers

example.en: Thank you for your warm hospitality during our visit.
example.zh: 感谢你们在我们来访期间的盛情款待。

senses.en: large and having plenty of space

example.en: The living room is bright and spacious.
example.zh: 客厅明亮而宽敞。

senses.en: a group of countries or states ruled by one ruler or government

example.en: The Roman Empire controlled much of Europe for centuries.
example.zh: 罗马帝国曾控制欧洲大片地区达数个世纪之久。

senses.en: a large organization or business controlled by one person or group
senses.zh: 庞大的企业集团；大企业帝国

example.en: She built a media empire from a single small magazine.
example.zh: 她从一本小杂志起家，建立了一个传媒帝国。

senses.en: a statement or idea accepted as true, used as the basis for an argument or conclusion

example.en: The argument rests on a false premise.
example.zh: 这个论证建立在一个错误的前提之上。

senses.en: premises: a building and the land it stands on
senses.zh: （复数）房屋及其附属场地；经营场所

example.en: Alcohol is not permitted on the premises.
example.zh: 场所内禁止饮酒。

senses.en: to state something in advance as a basis for reasoning

example.en: The plan is premised on continued economic growth.
example.zh: 该计划以经济持续增长为前提。

senses.en: to scatter drops of liquid or small pieces over something

example.en: She sprinkled some sugar on the cake.
example.zh: 她在蛋糕上撒了一些糖。

senses.en: to rain lightly in small drops

example.en: It started to sprinkle just before noon.
example.zh: 中午前开始下起了小雨。

senses.en: a small amount of something scattered; a light rain

example.en: Add a sprinkle of salt to the soup.
example.zh: 往汤里加一点点盐。

senses.en: containing a lot of things or people close together

example.en: The city has a dense population.
example.zh: 这座城市人口稠密。

senses.en: difficult to see through because thick

example.en: A dense fog covered the valley.
example.zh: 浓雾笼罩着山谷。

senses.en: informal: slow to understand things

example.en: He's a bit dense, so explain it slowly.
example.zh: 他有点迟钝，所以要慢慢解释。

senses.en: to officially choose someone or something for a particular purpose or role

example.en: The committee designated her as team leader.
example.zh: 委员会指定她为团队负责人。

senses.en: to give a name or title to something

example.en: The park was designated a national monument.
example.zh: 该公园被定为国家纪念地。

senses.en: holding a title but not yet officially in office
senses.zh: 已获任命但尚未就任的

example.en: The ambassador designate was introduced at the ceremony.
example.zh: 仪式上介绍了候任大使。

senses.en: the act of leaving a job or position formally

example.en: She handed in her resignation after ten years at the company.
example.zh: 在这家公司工作十年后，她递交了辞呈。

senses.en: quiet acceptance of something unpleasant that cannot be changed

example.en: He accepted the delay with quiet resignation.
example.zh: 他默默地、无可奈何地接受了延误。

senses.en: to mock or insult someone in order to make them angry or upset

example.en: The other kids taunted him about his mistake.
example.zh: 其他孩子嘲笑他的错误。

senses.en: a cruel or mocking remark meant to upset someone

example.en: He ignored the taunts of his rivals.
example.zh: 他没有理会对手们的嘲讽。

senses.en: the hard pointed mouth of a bird

example.en: The eagle held the fish in its beak.
example.zh: 鹰用喙叼着鱼。

senses.en: a similar mouthpart of some other animals, such as turtles or octopuses

example.en: The turtle grasped the seaweed with its beak.
example.zh: 海龟用嘴咬住了海草。

senses.en: to claim or appear to be something, often without proof

example.en: The study purports to show a link between the two factors.
example.zh: 该研究声称证明了这两个因素之间的联系。

senses.en: the general meaning or main substance of something

example.en: The purport of his message was clear.
example.zh: 他传话的要旨很清楚。

senses.en: the study of how air moves around objects, especially vehicles

example.en: Good aerodynamics helps a car use less fuel.
example.zh: 良好的空气动力学设计能帮助汽车省油。

senses.en: relating to the work of a secretary

example.en: She took a course in secretarial skills.
example.zh: 她修了一门秘书技能课程。

senses.en: a small fenced field for horses, or the area where racehorses are prepared before a race

example.en: The jockeys led their horses into the paddock before the race.
example.zh: 赛前骑师们把马牵进了检录场。

senses.en: an early 20th-century art style using geometric shapes and planes

example.en: Cubism broke objects into geometric shapes seen from many angles.
example.zh: 立体主义把物体分解成从多个角度看到的几何形状。

senses.en: a person who regularly drinks too much alcohol

example.en: The old man was known in the village as a drunkard.
example.zh: 那位老人在村里是有名的酒鬼。

senses.en: a person skilled in planning tactics
senses.zh: 战术家，善于谋划战术的人

example.en: The coach is known as a brilliant tactician.
example.zh: 这位教练被认为是出色的战术家。

senses.en: an offensive word for a very stupid person

example.en: He called the driver an imbecile after being cut off in traffic.
example.zh: 在车流中被抢道后，他骂那名司机是蠢货。

senses.en: to hide or contradict what something is really like

example.en: His calm smile belied the stress he was under.
example.zh: 他平静的笑容掩盖了他所承受的压力。

senses.en: able to adjust easily to new conditions or uses

example.en: She is adaptable and quickly adjusted to the new workplace.
example.zh: 她适应能力强，很快就适应了新工作环境。

senses.en: able to be modified for different purposes

example.en: The software is adaptable to different operating systems.
example.zh: 该软件可适配不同的操作系统。

senses.en: a central point or pin on which something turns; a key person or thing
senses.zh: 枢轴；支点；中心；关键（人物）

example.en: The door turns on a pivot at the top and bottom.
example.zh: 门依靠上下两端的枢轴转动。

senses.en: to turn or change direction around a central point

example.en: The company pivoted to online sales during the crisis.
example.zh: 危机期间公司转向线上销售。

senses.en: careful with money and avoiding waste

example.en: He lives a frugal life and saves most of his income.
example.zh: 他过着节俭的生活，把大部分收入都存起来。

senses.en: plural of exam; informal word for tests of knowledge or skill
senses.zh: 考试（exam的复数，exam是examination的非正式说法）

example.en: She passed all her final exams.
example.zh: 她通过了所有期末考试。

senses.en: a usual behavior that someone repeats often without thinking

example.en: Good eating habits are important for your health.
example.zh: 良好的饮食习惯对你的健康很重要。

senses.en: a special set of clothes worn by members of a religious order

example.en: The nun wore a simple grey habit.
example.zh: 那位修女穿着简朴的灰色会服。
